.²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the king Vatsa; {#prApyAvantInudayanakaTAkovidagrAmavfdDAn#}
 <ls>Me. 30</ls>. [A celebrated Prince of the lunar race, who is usually styled Vatsarāja.
 He reigned at Kauśambī. Vāsavadattā, Princess of Ujjayinī, saw him
 in a dream and fell in love with him. He was decoyed to that city and
 there kept in prison by Chaṇḍamahāsena, the king. But on being released
 by the minister, he carried off Vāsavadattā from her father and a rival
 suitor. Udayana is the hero of the play called Ratnāvalī and his life
 has been made the subject of several other minor

 compositions. See Vatsa also].
<ab>N.</ab> of a philosopher and author of several works.
